title: ESQ-Bench：面向企业Oracle数据库的NL2SQL方言泛化与静默语义分歧评估基准
summary: ESQ-Bench是首个面向企业Oracle的NL2SQL基准，包含三个复杂度层级、465张表、550个问答对，并在四种数据库上提供相同数据。评估显示GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4.6在执行匹配率上随层级下降，静默分歧率高，而开源模型表现差距大。
summary_en: ESQ-Bench is the first Oracle-first NL2SQL benchmark with three complexity tiers, 465 tables, and 550 question-query pairs, provided across four databases. Evaluation shows GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6 degrade in execution match across tiers, high silent divergence, and a large gap for open-weight models.
